title: ReplayMod AutoMarker
description: Automatically places markers on ReplayMod recordings when in-game events happen
body:
# ReplayMod AutoMarker

Forgot the timestamp again? AutoMarker marks it for you.

While you play, it drops a named marker on your ReplayMod timeline whenever something happens, so the highlights are already waiting when you open the replay.

## What's get marked?

- Deaths 
- PvP kills
- Totem of Undying pops
- Advancements
- Dimension changes
- Your own chat keywords

## Configuration

Press **K** in-game, or use Mod Menu. Toggle any marker, set keywords as a comma-separated list (`marker, highlight, raid`).

Needs Minecraft 1.20+, Fabric API, and ReplayMod.
